description: This file contains a Python async function to seed the database with a sample video entry if the videos table is empty. It manages media directories, creates placeholder files if needed, and inserts a Video record into the database.

classes.name: Video
classes.description: A SQLAlchemy ORM model representing video records in the database.

methods.name: bool seed_if_empty(session: AsyncSession, sample_video_path: Optional[Path] = None)
methods.description: Checks if the videos table is empty; if so, creates a sample video record, and optionally copies a sample video file into media storage. Returns True if seeding was performed, False otherwise.

ctags.name: seed_if_empty
ctags.pattern: /^async def seed_if_empty(session: AsyncSession, sample_video_path: Optional[Path] = None) -> bool/
